name: Raven
overview: The raven, a black carnivorous bird, is noted in Scripture as being forbidden as food (Leviticus 11:15; Deuteronomy 14:14) and plays a significant role in God's providential care. In Genesis 8:7, Noah sent forth a raven to scout the drying earth after the flood. Later, God commanded ravens to feed the prophet Elijah by bringing him bread and meat morning and evening while he drank from the brook Cherith (1 Kings 17:4-6), demonstrating divine provision through creation.
